counting_note: Unique supporting event records, not occurrences or automatic future assignments. Some concepts are optional facets, conditional evidence, existing-art reuse, or unproven recognition studies. Prior stale/deferred reviews are excluded; previous DB rows were not edited.

shortlist.label: Acoustic guitar
shortlist.visual_brief: Rounded wooden body, large sound hole and clear bridge. Noto guitar is electric.
shortlist.limits: Use for confirmed acoustic performance or acoustic-focused instruction; guitar alone and genre do not prove construction.

reviewed_variants.visual: Rounded wooden guitar with circular sound hole and short fretted neck.
reviewed_variants.rationale: An explicitly acoustic guitar performance benefits from its hollow-body identity.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto guitar depicts an electric body; no acoustic-guitar custom.

reviewed_variants.visual: Rounded hollow guitar body with a prominent sound hole and short fretted neck.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Acoustic performance deserves a visibly hollow-body option.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto guitar is an electric guitar; no separate acoustic option in catalog.

reviewed_variants.visual: A rounded wooden guitar with a large dark sound hole and simple bridge, angled upright.
reviewed_variants.rationale: The program explicitly features classical acoustic guitar; body and soundhole distinguish it from electric guitar at small sizes.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto guitar depicts an electric solid body and misses the acoustic instrument identity.

reviewed_variants.visual: A rounded wooden figure-eight guitar body with a large sound hole and six-string neck.
reviewed_variants.rationale: An explicitly acoustic featured guitarist has a body silhouette different from electric guitar.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto guitar is an electric solid-body design; ukulele and banjo differ in size and construction.

reviewed_variants.visual: A rounded wooden guitar with a large dark sound hole and simple bridge, angled upright.
reviewed_variants.rationale: The solo folk set explicitly features acoustic guitar and vocals; body and sound hole distinguish it from the electric guitar artwork.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto guitar depicts an electric solid body and misses the acoustic instrument identity.

reviewed_variants.visual: A wooden hollow guitar with a large round sound hole.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Acoustic guitar performance or acoustic-focused guitar instruction is explicitly supported by the event context; some classes also allow electric instruments.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Bundled Noto guitar depicts an electric instrument; an acoustic sound-hole silhouette adds specificity where appropriate.

reviewed_variants.visual: Rounded wooden guitar body with central sound hole and short headstock.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Classical guitar performances explicitly identify acoustic classical instrument tradition.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: The bundled Noto guitar SVG has a red electric body with pickguard and pickups; classical acoustic guitar needs the hollow wooden body and central sound hole.

shortlist.label: Knitting needles
shortlist.visual_brief: Two broad needles forming a clear loop above a small swatch. Distinguishes knitting from crochet and plain yarn.
shortlist.limits: Mixed knit/crochet groups remain broad; no machine knitting implied.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two pointed needles crossing through a short thick knitted swatch with a yarn ball.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Paired needles clearly distinguish knitting from single-hook crochet at small sizes.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Yarn ball covers all fiber crafts; current crochet icon is technically different.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two crossed knitting needles carrying a short row of large knit stitches.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Separates two-needle knitting from crochet and generic yarn. For mixed fiber gatherings this is a supported facet, not automatically the primary activity.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto yarn is generic; custom crochet depicts a different single-hook method.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two crossed needles holding a short row of large yarn loops.
reviewed_variants.rationale: The program explicitly includes knitting; paired needles distinguish its technique from crochet. Keep mixed-fiber events broad until a combined or dominant activity is established.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Yarn shows material but not technique; the new crochet icon uses a different single-hook method.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two needles crossed through a small row of yarn stitches.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Knitting practice explicitly involves a distinct paired-needle technique.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Yarn emoji identifies material only; machine sewing depicts a different activity.

reviewed_variants.visual: Paired needles holding a small row of stitches.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Casting on knit stitch and binding off are explicit.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Yarn emoji does not depict the paired-needle technique.

reviewed_variants.visual: Paired needles through a row of stitches.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Knitting practice explicitly defines the event.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Yarn does not distinguish technique.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two needles holding a small yarn swatch.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Knitting with supplied patterns is one of the two stated activity choices.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Thread/yarn emoji loses technique; sewing machine would be incorrect.

reviewed_variants.visual: Paired needles holding knit-and-purl stitches.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Class explicitly teaches knit purl cast-on and bind-off.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Yarn lacks the technique distinction.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two separated knitting needles holding a short looped swatch.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Knitting is explicitly the technique being taught.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Thread/yarn does not show needle knitting; crochet uses a different tool.

shortlist.label: Binoculars
shortlist.visual_brief: Two chunky barrels with large lenses and a broad bridge. Communicates observation rather than an animal alone.
shortlist.limits: Counts include birding symbolism and one museum observation kit. They do not establish supplied equipment or exclusive use.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two broad binocular barrels joined by a short bridge.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Conveys active wildlife observation rather than simply an animal; a birding icon direction need not assert every attendee uses binoculars.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto bird identifies wildlife but not the birdwatching activity; no dedicated binocular emoji exists.

reviewed_variants.visual: Compact paired binocular barrels with large eyepieces and central bridge.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Guided bird observation has a recognizable tool silhouette distinct from the bird itself.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Bird emoji shows subject but not observing; no binoculars option in Noto.

reviewed_variants.visual: A compact pair of binoculars with two large front lenses and a curved bridge.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Birding is explicit; binoculars can identify observation rather than simply an animal subject, though not proof of required equipment.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Bird conveys subject but not watching; telescope usually implies astronomy.

reviewed_variants.visual: A compact pair of binoculars with two large front lenses and a curved bridge.
reviewed_variants.rationale: The museum backpack explicitly supplies binoculars for inspecting details in art; this is one observation tool among several activities, not birdwatching.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Magnifying glass is a related existing observation cue; binoculars would show the actual tool. The mixed backpack program remains broad.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two short dark barrels with large blue front lenses joined by a central hinge.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Birdwatching is central; binoculars communicate observing birds rather than merely the bird subject. The description need not promise supplied equipment, and usage should be verified before an equipment-specific assignment.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto bird depicts subject but not observation; telescope is wrong form; no current custom.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two chunky optical barrels joined by a broad central hinge.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Birdwatching is explicitly the activity; binoculars are a proposed observation symbol. Only some descriptions establish supplied equipment.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Bird depicts the subject, while binoculars convey observation. Do not infer equipment supply or mandatory use from this opportunity.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two chunky optical barrels joined by a broad central hinge.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Bird identification class explicitly teaches use of supplied binoculars.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Telescope depicts different equipment; binoculars are recognizable at small sizes.

shortlist.limits: Two general harmonica records plus a separate chromatic-harmonica record. Prototype shared family art, preserving the subtype in metadata.

reviewed_variants.visual: A slim rectangular silver harmonica with one row of dark blow holes.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Explicit virtuoso harmonica performance needs a specific compact instrument silhouette.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto guitar/microphone loses harmonica identity; no corresponding custom.

reviewed_variants.visual: A slim rectangular silver harmonica with one row of dark blow holes.
reviewed_variants.rationale: The performer biography and event tags explicitly identify harmonica specialization. The candidate is supported, but the exact instrumental balance of this concert is not stated.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto guitar/microphone loses harmonica identity; no corresponding custom.

shortlist.label: Hand embroidery
shortlist.visual_brief: One large hoop with a few bold stitches and a threaded needle.
shortlist.limits: Keep hand embroidery separate from machine embroidery; narrower bead, cross-stitch, Bargello and mirrorwork techniques may share art only after review.

reviewed_variants.visual: A round hoop holding cloth with one broad stitched flower and a needle.
reviewed_variants.rationale: A hoop and stitched cloth distinguish embroidery from general sewing; in mixed gatherings this is only one supported facet.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto sewing needle lacks the taut fabric and hoop; sewing-machine icon is the wrong technique.

reviewed_variants.visual: A round hoop with a simple stitched flower and needle crossing its rim.
reviewed_variants.rationale: The sampler and hand stitches distinguish embroidery from machine sewing and general mending.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Needle is already suitable; hoop and stitched motif add technique recognition without requiring a machine.

reviewed_variants.visual: A round embroidery hoop with a few broad stitched petals and a needle.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Embroidery is explicitly offered and has a distinct hoop-and-stitch activity cue, though the full event remains mixed.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Thread/yarn are materials and machine sewing depicts another process; evaluate existing sewing-needle artwork before new art.

reviewed_variants.visual: Round wooden hoop with taut cloth, a simple stitched flower and a threaded needle.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Explicit embroidery instruction uses decorative stitches in framed fabric, unlike machine sewing or crochet.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto sewing needle lacks hoop and stitched artwork; no current custom.

reviewed_variants.visual: Fabric hoop with a large stitched flower and a needle pulling thread
reviewed_variants.rationale: Decorative stitching on cloth is more specific than a sewing needle alone and differs from machine seams, knitting and crochet. Avoid a hoop when event technique does not use one unless treated as a broad craft symbol.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Sewing needle or thread emoji

shortlist.label: Cyanotype
shortlist.visual_brief: A deep blue print containing one high-contrast white botanical silhouette.
shortlist.limits: Confirmed cyanotype only; not every unspecified sun print uses this process.

reviewed_variants.visual: A deep blue paper sheet with a crisp white leaf silhouette and one corner sun ray.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Blue-and-white contact printing is a distinctive photographic process, unlike ordinary camera photography.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto film or camera does not depict a sun-exposed blue print.

reviewed_variants.visual: Blue photographic sheet with a white leaf silhouette beneath a simple sun mark
reviewed_variants.rationale: Cyanotype is explicitly named and prints are made using negatives, exposure and development. The blue-white print distinguishes it from generic painting or uncertain sun-print methods.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Camera or sun emoji

reviewed_variants.visual: Deep blue paper square with a crisp white leaf silhouette and a small sun at one corner.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Explicit cyanotype art uses light-exposed silhouette prints distinct from paint/collage.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto camera/palette omit blue photogram process; no custom. Verify subject materials before showing leaf-specific assignment.

reviewed_variants.visual: A cyan-blue print with a white leaf silhouette and a small sun corner.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Sun-developed camera-less blue printing is explicitly taught; blue-and-white negative is distinctive.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Sun alone suggests weather; camera misrepresents the camera-less process, and general printmaking loses the blue chemistry.

shortlist.label: Pipe organ
shortlist.visual_brief: A compact graduated rank of broad silver pipes; keyboard only if it remains legible.
shortlist.limits: Four records at two stored venues, including a conditional cathedral-organ construction inference (240776). Confirm before exclusive assignment.

reviewed_variants.visual: Five graduated organ pipes rising above a small keyboard.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Explicit organ performance needs its pipe-bank identity rather than a generic keyboard.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto musical keyboard has no pipes; no current custom organ.

reviewed_variants.visual: Five large stepped organ pipes over a short keyboard.
reviewed_variants.rationale: A cathedral organ recital explicitly features the organ; the cathedral setting supports a pipe-organ visual, to verify before assignment.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Piano keys omit the organ pipes and sustained-air instrument identity.

shortlist.label: Clay handbuilding
shortlist.visual_brief: Hands shaping a single pinch pot, without a wheel.
shortlist.limits: Mixed wheel/handbuilding classes may contribute both concepts without an exclusive assignment.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two hands pinching the rim of a soft clay bowl.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Clay shaping by hand is clearer than a finished vessel, especially for open child sculpture activities.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Amphora depicts an artifact; no wheel equipment should be inferred and no handbuilding custom icon exists.

reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Amphora depicts finished pottery; pottery wheel would contradict the supplied method.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two hands shaping a small pinch pot without a wheel.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Handbuilding or shaping clay is explicit in the event context; wheel work is only included where separately documented.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Amphora shows finished pottery; a wheel would imply equipment absent from handbuilding-only sessions.

reviewed_variants.visual: Two hands shaping a small irregular clay form.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Air-dry clay shapes and figures are created by participants.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Masonry brick is wrong material cue; amphora shows finished pottery rather than hand modeling.

reviewed_variants.visual: Hands pinching and shaping a clay form.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Handbuilding is explicitly the workshop technique.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Amphora shows ceramic result but not hand technique; wheel or machine use cannot be assumed.

shortlist.label: Quilting
shortlist.visual_brief: One bold four-patch square with a clear stitched edge.
shortlist.limits: Do not conflate with knitting, crochet, or assume hand versus machine production.

reviewed_variants.visual: A square patchwork quilt with four large contrasting fabric blocks and one stitched diagonal.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Shows assembled patchwork rather than generic sewing; mixed fiber gatherings provide facet support only.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto thread and needle do not show patchwork assembly, and machine sewing cannot be assumed.

reviewed_variants.visual: A square four-patch quilt with a diagonal stitch line.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Dedicated quilting centers joining layered patchwork, distinct from knitting/crochet or unspecified sewing.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Noto thread/needle is generic; machine-sewing custom would assert equipment not specified.

reviewed_variants.visual: A small padded patchwork square with four large color blocks and two visible stitched seams.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Quilting is the explicit project technique; patchwork/padded fabric adds specificity beyond the current sewing machine while preserving that accurate assignment.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Thread is broad and sewing machine shows method but not quilt construction.

reviewed_variants.visual: A patchwork square with contrasting stitched seams.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Weekly quilters gathering is explicit without evidence of machine versus hand work.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Thread identifies material while a patchwork block conveys quilting specifically.

reviewed_variants.visual: Four contrasting fabric squares with large stitched seams and a threaded needle.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Quilting or a quilt-square project is explicitly offered.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Yarn and thread show material; patchwork construction can identify quilting without presuming hand or machine sewing.

reviewed_variants.visual: Folded paper crane with clearly creased triangular wings.

reviewed_variants.visual: A single folded paper crane with crisp broad facets.
reviewed_variants.rationale: Participants make folded-paper origami animals.
reviewed_variants.existing_alternative: Swan emoji depicts a living bird; a folded crane makes the paper technique explicit.
